overview.description: The Cohen & Steers Short Duration Preferred and Income Active ETF (CSSD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund seeks total return through an actively managed global portfolio of preferred and income-producing debt securities. The fund may invest up to 50% in high-yield securities. CSSD was launched on Dec 9, 2025 and is issued by Cohen & Steers.
